subtitle: "Evidence-based modelling for nonhuman leadership"

These appendices accompany the study *Evidence-based modelling for nonhuman leadership: can trees, birds, and lizards shape pathways to better futures?* They document the concepts, places, personas, habitat data, resistance measures and pathway simulation used in the study.

## Appendices

| Appendix | Subject |
|:--|:--|
| [A. Glossary](appendix_A_glossary.qmd) | Terms used in the study |
| [B. Places](appendix_B_places.qmd) | Case places and their urban context |
| [C. Personas, capabilities and relational indicators](appendix_C_personas_capabilities_and_relational_indicators.qmd) | Persona characteristics and capability measures |
| [D. Habitat features](appendix_D_habitat_features.qmd) | Feature origins, calibration and workflow |
| [E. Habitat volumes](appendix_E_habitat_volumes.qmd) | Spatial representation and processing |
| [F. Resistance](appendix_F_resistance.qmd) | Resistance measures and connectivity |
| [G. Pathway simulation](appendix_G_pathway_simulation.qmd) | Proposals, interventions and model operation |
| [G.1 Tree growth](appendix_G_pathway_simulation_growth-submodule.qmd) | Growth model details |
| [G.2 Tree lifecycle phase](appendix_G_pathway_simulation_lifecycle-submodule.qmd) | Lifecycle categories and evidence |
| [G.3 Recruit and mortality dynamics](appendix_G_pathway_simulation_recruit-mortality-submodule.qmd) | Recruitment and mortality parameters |
| [H. Baseline woodlands](appendix_H_baseline_woodlands.qmd) | Woodland baseline categories and estimates |

Use the contents panel to move between appendices. Each page includes a page contents list for navigation within longer sections.
